title: Core Quintet #08
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Latina woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, cheerful, soft pastel-pink hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Escher-inspired tessellation — a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: reclining on her side, propped on one elbow.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Latina woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, bold and confident, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting — a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Indian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, cheerful, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in low bun, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Turkish İznik tile — a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Center woman's footwear: extreme cobalt-and-coral ankle-strap stilettos, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, demure and soft, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay — a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands following every deep crease, dense lattice fills filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.

Right woman's footwear: extreme bold silver platform stiletto peep-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, bold and confident, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Peruvian Nazca painted pattern — a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense stepped geometric borders filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
